name: Astrielle
source:
Astrielle is a supervillain who embodies the dazzling power of light and the arcane power of gems. A master of light manipulation, she can create barriers of pure luminous energy that protect her from any attack, while her bursts of blinding light knock down enemies, leaving them disoriented and vulnerable. With her control over gems, she can amplify her powers, making each move as spectacular as it is lethal. Her presence is a bright symbol of destruction, capable of annihilating anyone who dares challenge her.
